- Bulk energy: E_bulk = -1679.86275358002 eV
- Surface energy: E_surface = -1631.81097242534 eV
- Energy difference: ΔE = E_surface - E_bulk = -1631.81097242534 - (-1679.86275358002) = 48.05178115468 eV
- Box dimensions: Lx = 20.19465 Å, Ly = 20.19465 Å
- Surface area (one surface): A = Lx × Ly = 20.19465 × 20.19465 = 407.8238 Å²
- Two surfaces are created (top and bottom), so total area = 2 × A = 815.6476 Å²
- Surface energy: γ = ΔE / (2 × A) = 48.05178115468 / 815.6476 = 0.0589 eV/Å²
